stem:
Multiple choice question: Meena's grandmother says that a dry rajma seed kept in a jar for many months is still a living thing. Which of the following reasons best supports grandmother's statement ( )
A. The seed shows all life processes like active growth and movement while lying in the jar
B. The seed is living because it has the ability to germinate and show life processes when given water, air and warmth
C. The seed is non-living because it does not move from place to place like an animal
D. The seed is living because it is hard and brown in colour

options.text: The seed shows all life processes like active growth and movement while lying in the jar
The seed is living because it has the ability to germinate and show life processes when given water, air and warmth
The seed is non-living because it does not move from place to place like an animal
The seed is living because it is hard and brown in colour

teacher.key_rationale: A dormant seed is living: it retains the capacity to carry out life processes (germination, growth, respiration) once favourable conditions are provided. Movement alone is not the test of life, and dormant seeds do not actively show all processes in the dry state, so only B is correct.
